title: WebSockets and stateful connection servers

kcs.statement: A WebSocket starts as an HTTP request with an Upgrade header and then becomes a persistent, full-duplex TCP connection on which both client and server can send frames at any time.

A server holding WebSocket connections is stateful because each connection lives on one server, so the load balancer must support long-lived connections and capacity is planned by concurrent connections per server rather than by QPS.

problem_ideas: 10M concurrent users, 50,000 connections per server: how many connection servers plus 30% headroom?
